name: Mighty Kong

features.name: Expanding middle wild
features.description: Wilds on the middle reel expand to fill it.

features.name: Choose your bonus
features.description: Select up to 40 free spins or multipliers up to 8x.

review:
A 2016 50-line game about a giant gorilla. A wild landing on the middle reel expands to fill it, hitting lots of lines.

The free spins let you choose your bonus – up to 40 spins or multipliers up to 8x – so you trade spins against multiplier size. The RTP is a low 94%, so it's more expensive to play over time. Mostly interesting for the choose-your-bonus idea.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
